label: Chapter 07

sentences.en: The optimal state of inner experience is one in which there is order in consciousness.
sentences.zh: 内心体验的最佳状态，是意识中有秩序的状态。

sentences.en: This happens when psychic energy – or attention – is invested in realistic goals, and when skills match the opportunities for action.
sentences.zh: 当心理能量——也就是注意力——投入到现实的目标中，并且技能与行动机会相匹配时，这种状态就会出现。

sentences.en: The pursuit of a goal brings order in awareness because a person must concentrate attention on the task at hand and momentarily forget everything else.
sentences.zh: 追求目标会让意识变得井然有序，因为一个人必须把注意力集中在手头的任务上，并暂时忘掉其他一切。

sentences.en: – from Flow, by Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi
sentences.zh: ——摘自米哈里·契克森米哈伊《心流》

sentences.en: You now have all of the components that lead to a good life.
sentences.zh: 你现在已经拥有了通向美好生活的所有要素。

sentences.en: Now, it may be helpful to organize all of your insights into one coherent plan.
sentences.zh: 现在，把你所有的领悟整理成一个连贯的计划可能会很有帮助。

sentences.en: Pull out a new page and write down these 6 components:
sentences.zh: 拿出一张新纸，写下这 6 个要素：

sentences.en: Anti-vision – What is the bane of my existence, or the life I never want to experience again?
sentences.zh: 反愿景——什么是我存在的祸根，或者说我再也不想经历的生活？

sentences.en: Vision – What is the ideal life that I think I want and can improve as I work toward it?
sentences.zh: 愿景——我认为自己想要的理想生活是什么？在朝着它努力的过程中，我又可以如何不断完善它？

sentences.en: 1 year goal – What will my life look like in 1 year time, and is that closer to the life I want?
sentences.zh: 1 年目标——1 年后我的生活会是什么样子？那是否更接近我想要的生活？

sentences.en: 1 month project – What do I need to learn? What skills do I need to acquire? What can I build that will move me closer to the one year goal?
sentences.zh: 1 个月项目——我需要学习什么？我需要获得哪些技能？我能打造什么来让我更接近 1 年目标？

sentences.en: Daily levers – What are the priority, needle-moving tasks that bring my project closer to completion?
sentences.zh: 每日杠杆——哪些是优先的、能真正推动进展的任务，可以让我的项目更接近完成？

sentences.en: Constraints – What am I not willing to sacrifice to achieve my vision from the ground up?
sentences.zh: 约束条件——为了从零实现我的愿景，我不愿意牺牲什么？

sentences.en: Why is this so powerful?
sentences.zh: 为什么它如此强大？

sentences.en: Because these components literally create your own little world.
sentences.zh: 因为这些要素真的创造出了属于你自己的小世界。

sentences.en: If you are meant to pursue this hierarchy, then these components become your lens on the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你注定要去追求这个层级结构，那么这些要素就会成为你看待世界的透镜。

sentences.en: Every time you enter that world, your mind searches the environment for new opportunities to achieve that goal.
sentences.zh: 每一次你进入那个世界，你的大脑都会在环境中搜寻实现那个目标的新机会。

sentences.en: You turn your life into a video game.
sentences.zh: 你把人生变成了一场电子游戏。

sentences.en: Because games are the poster child for obsession, enjoyment, and flow states.
sentences.zh: 因为游戏是痴迷、享受和心流状态的典型代表。

sentences.en: They have all the components that make them fun.
sentences.zh: 它们具备所有让它们有趣的要素。

sentences.en: They are all a part of this exact hierarchy that we expanded on just before.
sentences.zh: 它们都是我们刚刚展开讲过的这个层级结构的一部分。

sentences.en: Your vision is how you win.
sentences.zh: 你的愿景就是你获胜的方式。

sentences.en: At least until the game evolves.
sentences.zh: 至少在游戏进化之前是如此。

sentences.en: Your anti-vision is what's at stake.
sentences.zh: 你的反愿景就是赌注所在。

sentences.en: What happens if you lose or give up.
sentences.zh: 如果你输了或者放弃了，会发生什么。

sentences.en: Your 1 year goal is the mission.
sentences.zh: 你的 1 年目标就是任务。

sentences.en: This is your sole priority in life.
sentences.zh: 这是你人生中唯一的优先事项。

sentences.en: Your 1 month project is the boss fight.
sentences.zh: 你的 1 个月项目就是 Boss 战。

sentences.en: How you gain XP and acquire loot.
sentences.zh: 这就是你获得经验值、缴获战利品的方式。

sentences.en: Your daily levers are the quests.
sentences.zh: 你的每日杠杆就是支线任务。

sentences.en: The daily process that unlocks new opportunities.
sentences.zh: 是开启新机会的日常过程。

sentences.en: Your constraints are the rules.
sentences.zh: 你的约束条件就是规则。

sentences.en: The limitations that encourage creativity.
sentences.zh: 是鼓励创造力的种种限制。

sentences.en: All of these act as a concentric set of circles, like a forcefield, that guard your mind from distractions.
sentences.zh: 所有这些要素共同构成一组同心圆，就像一道力场，守护着你的心智，让它免受干扰。

sentences.en: They help you maintain focus on a single goal, and be pulled toward the things that actually move the needle.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助你保持专注于一个目标，并被真正能推动进展的事物所吸引。

sentences.en: The more you play the game, the stronger this force becomes, and soon enough it becomes who you are, and you wouldn't have it any other way.
sentences.zh: 你玩这场游戏越多，这股力量就变得越强，很快它就会成为你的一部分，而且你绝不会想要换成其他方式。

sentences.en: – Dan

title_en: VII – Turn Your Life Into A Video Game
title_zh: 七、把人生变成一场电子游戏

vocab.def_zh: 祸根；祸害；令人烦恼的事物
vocab.example_en: Constant interruptions were the bane of his deep work sessions.
In this hierarchy, the long-term vision sits above the yearly goal and the daily tasks.

vocab.def_zh: 同心的；共用同一圆心的
vocab.example_en: The diagram showed several concentric circles, each one representing a different level of the plan.
After finishing the difficult project, he treated the new skills he had gained as his loot.
